description: Returns VertoDigital's value proposition for a query - matched services, proof-point case studies, and/or differentiation reasons, each with a concrete stat. The `aspect` parameter narrows the response to a single category; omitting it returns all three. Read-only, no side effects; matches against each item's tagged keywords, not the live site's full text.

aspect.description: Narrow the response to one category: "services" (which VertoDigital service fits this challenge), "proof_points" (flagship case study stats), or "differentiators" (why clients choose VertoDigital). Omit to return all three.

query.description: Plain-language challenge, topic, industry, or client name to filter by. Examples: "we can't attribute our ad spend to pipeline", "SEO", "pricing", "SnapLogic". Omit to return everything unfiltered.

name: vertodigital_why_verto

differentiators.description: Matched reasons clients choose VertoDigital - present unless aspect narrows to another category

proof.description: The stat or fact backing this differentiator

proof_points.description: Matched flagship case-study proof points - present unless aspect narrows to another category

case_study_url.description: Full URL of the case study

stats.description: Headline results from the case study

services.description: Matched services - present unless aspect narrows to another category

pitch.description: One-paragraph description of how the service works

proof.description: Headline result and the client it came from

service_page.description: Path of the service page on vertodigital.com
